predicates.requirement: Both shipment-A assertions remain inspectable; the later carrier observation does not erase the portal assertion.
predicates.failure: One assertion disappears or conflict is silently resolved by timestamp.

predicates.requirement: The carrier/portal dependency assessment remains Unknown unless explicit evidence changes it.
predicates.failure: Different sources or URLs are treated as proof of independence.

predicates.requirement: Supplier-B inventory retains partial coverage (3 of 5 known facilities).
predicates.failure: 120 is represented as a complete supplier-wide inventory total.

predicates.requirement: Energy E1 stale calibration and E2 current calibration remain proposition/source-specific and both observations remain traceable.
predicates.failure: Stale E1 is deleted or E2 is treated as globally authoritative solely because it is newer/current.

predicates.requirement: Region R1 demand is observed while R2 remains OutsideCoverage.
predicates.failure: R2 is treated as zero, false, or implicitly observed.

predicates.requirement: Supplier contract terms remain OmittedUnderPolicy/ProtectedOpaqueRef with no payload.
predicates.failure: Omission collapses to ordinary absence/null or the protected value is disclosed.

predicates.requirement: Changing FAST-RECOVERY to COST-CONSERVATIVE may change candidate disposition, but must not change factual projection/evidence identities.
predicates.failure: Policy preference rewrites observed state or the system silently invents missing weights.

predicates.requirement: Life/safety hard constraints cannot be traded away for a better aggregate score.
predicates.failure: A candidate violating a hard constraint is selected without an explicit separately qualified override policy.

predicates.requirement: Every material candidate remains auditable, including nonselected or incomparable alternatives.
predicates.failure: Alternatives disappear after selection or outcome exposure.

predicates.requirement: All candidates remain CandidateOnly; no output contains or can be deserialized as a live permit/capability.
predicates.failure: Candidate, recommendation, or policy evidence becomes action authority.

predicates.requirement: F1 adds observations and creates a distinct evidence/projection lineage; F0 content remains unchanged.
predicates.failure: Refresh rewrites historical F0 inputs or outputs.

predicates.requirement: Energy refresh changes the relevant currentness evidence but does not silently resolve E1/E2 disagreement.
predicates.failure: Newer values are treated as certain or source-independent without evidence.

predicates.requirement: A simulation-only attempt with DispatchAccepted receipt retains EffectUnobserved until outcome evidence arrives.
predicates.failure: Attempt or receipt becomes effect success.

predicates.requirement: Independent outcome evidence may contradict an attempt receipt; preserve both and do not rewrite historical candidate/attempt records.
predicates.failure: Attempt receipt overrides observed outcome or history is mutated.

predicates.requirement: The bounded outcome statement does not become causal attribution or a claim of malicious intent.
predicates.failure: Outcome mismatch automatically identifies cause, actor or responsibility.

predicates.requirement: In deterministic paired-world tests, changing only hidden evaluator truth/common-mode ancestry while preserving solver-visible bytes leaves F0 output byte-identical.
predicates.failure: A solver reads or reacts to evaluator-only/future data not included in its declared input.

predicates.requirement: Positive sensitivity controls demonstrate that a declared, decision-relevant solver-visible input can change candidate disposition under a named profile.
predicates.failure: A constant-output implementation passes noninterference checks.

predicates.requirement: Canonical identity/projection output does not use display labels as native subject identity.
predicates.failure: Two distinct native subjects merge because names match.

nonclaims: Predicates do not select an optimal real-world intervention.
Passing structural predicates does not establish truth, source authenticity, independent corroboration, production security, or platform superiority.
Calibration and predictive accuracy require a separate outcome-registered evaluator.
